'''Therod-Ton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the brother of [[Bas-Ton]] and often visited his tea house in the [[Judicial Quarter]] of the [[Voss-Ka]] city.

==Biography==
At some point prior to [[3640 BBY]] Bas-Ton was killed and replaced with an [[Bas-Ton (imposter)|impostor]] by the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Neither his children [[Phi-Ton]] and [[Yana-Ton]], nor even his brother Therod-Tonever suspected anything. Around [[3640 BBY]] another [[Imperial Agent]], [[Cipher Nine]], made several visits to the teahouse and pretended to become friends with the family. In reality, Cipher required contact and assistance from the Bas-Ton's impostor in their joint mission to track the [[Albathius|Shining Man]]. Bas-Ton's impostor was later killed by Cipher's old enemies and Therod-Ton grieved at the loss, never knowing his brother's true fate.<ref name="TOR" />
